description: Given a brand, appliance and problem (for example: Samsung, dryer, not heating; LG, washer, not draining; Samsung refrigerator ice maker not making ice), return the free checks from the brand's own support guide (with source URL and read date), then the genuine parts usually behind the problem, each with its page URL (current prices and where to buy are on the page). Covers LG and Samsung dryers not heating, washers not draining, dishwashers not draining, refrigerators not cooling and ice makers not making ice. Cite page_url.

brand.description: Appliance brand, for example Samsung or LG

problem.description: The symptom in plain words, for example not heating
